import numpy as np
data = np.load('/work/fwd/r5/run.npz', allow_pickle=True)
print("Keys:", sorted(data.keys()))
l0_mlp = data['L0_MLP']
print(f"\nL0_MLP shape: {l0_mlp.shape}")  # [6, 10, 4]

# POSITION DEPENDENCE: input 0 (all 5s) - does write vary by position?
print("\n=== Input 0 (all 5s): L0_MLP writes per position ===")
ref = l0_mlp[0, 1]
for p in range(0, 10):
    diff = np.max(np.abs(l0_mlp[0, p] - ref))
    print(f"  pos {p}: {np.round(l0_mlp[0, p], 3)}, diff_from_pos1={diff:.4f}")

# TOKEN VARIATION at same position
print("\n=== Position 5, tokens 5/3/7 (uniform sequences) ===")
for i, tok in [(0,5),(1,3),(2,7)]:
    print(f"  token {tok}: {np.round(l0_mlp[i,5], 3)}")

# CONTEXT EFFECT: position 4, token=5, different preceding tokens
print("\n=== Context test: position 4 (token=5) ===")
print(f"  Input 3 (1,1,1 precede): {np.round(l0_mlp[3,4], 3)}")
print(f"  Input 4 (9,9,9 precede): {np.round(l0_mlp[4,4], 3)}")
ctx_diff = np.max(np.abs(l0_mlp[4,4] - l0_mlp[3,4]))
print(f"  Max context diff: {ctx_diff:.6f}")
print(f"  Context matters (>0.01): {ctx_diff > 0.01}")

print("  Got (ablated): [-2, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3]")

print("  - Ablating breaks predictions for most tokens → doing core work")
